headline: SpaceX shares dropped after its first earnings report as investors focused on its heavy AI spending.
score_reason: Pool score 5 lowered by 2: the SpaceX second-quarter results came out around 4 Aug 2026, two months before this article.
importance_line: Investors in SpaceX shares saw heavy AI spending outweigh a revenue beat, but this is old news now and the share price has since moved.
summary: Stocktwits reports that SpaceX shares fell about 8% in after-hours trading after the newly listed company posted second-quarter revenue of USD 7.8 billion, up 92% from a year earlier, but spent USD 18.4 billion on capital projects, USD 15.8 billion of it on AI. The results are from SpaceX's first earnings report since going public, not a new event today.
notes: Older news re-dated: the article says the results came "on Tuesday" and Google News coverage (Fortune, 4 Aug 2026; Reuters, CBS and qz.com, 5 Aug 2026) places the first SpaceX earnings report in early August. Stocktwits page date of 4 Oct 2026 is a republish. The page quotes a share price around USD 125, below the USD 135 IPO price.
